CustomField.formula: IF(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Finished-Goods Release"), "Complete", IF(ISBLANK(Start_Date__c), "No Start Date", IF(AND(NOT(Material_Ready__c), Start_Date__c - TODAY() <= 2), "At Risk", "On Track")))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Share of the planned quantity that has been completed. Calculated automatically from Completed Quantity and Planned Quantity.
CustomField.label: Schedule Risk
